title: 第1486章 真面目第1485章 宫中惊变
slug: 陆地键仙第1488章真神黄昏
lines: “为什么？”祖安十分不解，灵帝和皇后不应该是队友么，如今那么多真神虎视眈眈，他俩天然的同盟为何先同室操戈了。
“他准备以韩遂叛乱一事把何进调走，再对付我，扶持刘协当皇太子。”快乐与欲--望之神冷冷笑道，“原本以为当初秩序大典那件事过后他会吸取一点教训，结果现在发现他还是那般固执，想让一切都按照他规定的秩序运行，也不看看自己还有没有那个能力。”
他并不奇怪快乐与欲--望之神为何会知道这一切，连灵帝的心腹张让等人都已经投靠她了，自然会将他的计划说了出来。
意外的反而是汉灵帝的做法，他不过是秩序真神的一缕残魂，还玩这么大么。
这段日子他折腾的事情还真不少，取消曹操的西园校尉，把他改为黄门侍郎，得罪了守护真神。
提拔袁术手下孙坚为西园校尉，挑拨袁术和曹操之间的关系。
同时袁术、袁绍兄弟之间反目，虽然他们本身就互相不对付，但最近如此公开激烈的矛盾，恐怕背后有人在挑拨。
立自己为西园校尉，想来是打算利用他作为对付士族的一把刀。
明明当初是被寂灭仙祖暗算，如今却联合对方化身的董卓，制衡何皇后与皇子刘辩。
在民间则是焚毁所有非官方认可的兵法、百家杂学，重新定义儒家经典和官方颁布的《大汉秩序律》。
让知识成为只有官员才能触碰的禁脔，从根本上杜绝新思想的诞生……
这些想要控制一切的做法果然是秩序之神的本性，也难怪祂的人缘向来都不好。
“明明只剩下一缕残魂了，竟然还妄图算计这算计那，我如果什么都不管，他的那些布局就慢慢来合围我，我又岂会给他机会。”快乐与欲--望之神冷笑连连。
“那太后和二皇子呢？”祖安沉声问道。
“啧啧，你到底是担心二皇子呢，还是那位美艳的太后呀？”快乐与欲--望之神走到他身侧，指尖轻轻摩挲着他的下巴。
“我毕竟也是灵帝册封的皇叔，让我照拂两位皇子，我自然有责任保护他们的安全。”祖安答道。
“呵呵，辩儿不必你担忧，至于刘协，毕竟也是皇子，我暂时倒也不会杀他，但那位太后么。”快乐与欲--望之神忽然轻笑一声，“你这样担心她让我很吃醋啊。”
感受到对方那撩拨的动作，祖安也有些燥热，快乐与欲--望之神的能力没有谁能拒绝：“别闹了，只是觉得你跟长生之神合作恐怕未必有那么顺利，这个世界士族和宦官矛盾不可调和，你又收那些宦官为己用，迟早会出问题。”
“这就不用你操心了，如果想知道那位漂亮太后的消息，就看你的表现了。”
如今空气中尽是快乐与欲--望的神力，祖安看着她那妩媚风--烧--的模样，有一种狠狠惩罚对方的冲动。
快乐与欲--望之神发出一阵荡-人心-魄的笑声，修-长的腿很自然勾-住了他，两人滚-到了龙床之上。
殿中的侍女很默契地关上了门，明明皇帝刚驾崩，皇后就在这里跟别的男子厮混，但所有人似乎都已经习以为常了。
也不知道过了多久，忽然一声虎-吼，祖安震惊又愤怒的声音发出：“你对我做了什么？”
“不就是吸了一点灵魂碎片里的力量么，不必这么激动。”快乐与欲--望之神眉宇舒展，一脸心满意足的模样。

"Why?" Zu An was very puzzled. Shouldn't the Emperor Ling and the Queen be teammates? Now that so many true gods are eyeing him, why would their natural alliance start fighting in the same room?
"He planned to transfer He Jin out because of Han Sui's rebellion, then deal with me, and support Liu Xie as the crown prince." The God of Happiness and Desire sneered. "I originally thought that he would learn some lessons after the incident at the Order Ceremony, but now I find that he is still so stubborn, wanting everything to run according to the order he prescribed, and not looking to see if he still has the ability."
Zu An: "..."
He didn't wonder why the God of Joy and Desire knew all this. Even Ling Emperor's confidants Zhang Rang and others had already taken refuge in her, so they would naturally reveal his plan.
What was unexpected was what Emperor Ling of the Han Dynasty did. He was just a remnant soul of the True God of Order, so how could he play such a big role?
He really had a lot of troubles during these days. He canceled Cao Cao's Xiyuan School Captain and changed him to Huangmen Shilang, which offended the true guardian god.
Promoted Yuan Shu's subordinate Sun Jian to Xiyuan Campus Lieutenant to sow discord between Yuan Shu and Cao Cao.
At the same time, the brothers Yuan Shu and Yuan Shao were at odds with each other. Although they themselves did not deal with each other, with such open and fierce conflicts recently, I am afraid that someone is instigating them behind the scenes.
He made himself the captain of Xiyuan School, presumably with the intention of using him as a sword against the nobles.
It was clear that he was plotted by the Immortal Ancestor of Annihilation, but now he joins forces with Dong Zhuo, the other person's incarnation, to check and balance Queen He and Prince Liu Bian.
Among the people, they burned all unofficially recognized art of war and miscellany, and redefined Confucian classics and the officially promulgated "Laws of the Han Dynasty."
Let knowledge become a taboo that only officials can touch, and fundamentally prevent the birth of new ideas...
These attempts to control everything are indeed the nature of the God of Order. It is no wonder that His popularity has always been poor.
"Obviously there is only a ray of remnant soul left, but he is still trying to scheme this and that. If I don't care about anything, his plans will slowly surround me. How can I give him a chance." The God of Happiness and Desire sneered again and again.
"What about the Queen Mother and the Second Prince?" Zu An asked in a deep voice.
"Tsk tsk, are you worried about the second prince, or the beautiful Queen Mother?" The God of Joy and Desire walked to his side and gently stroked his chin with his fingertips.
"After all, I am also the emperor's uncle canonized by Emperor Ling. If I am asked to take care of the two princes, I naturally have the responsibility to protect their safety." Zu An replied.
"Haha, Bian'er doesn't need you to worry. As for Liu Xie, he is also a prince after all. I won't kill him for the time being, but the Queen Mother." The God of Happiness and Desire suddenly chuckled, "You worry about her like this makes me very jealous."
Feeling the other party's provocative movements, Zu An was also a little excited. No one could refuse the power of the God of Happiness and Desire: "Stop it, I just feel that your cooperation with the God of Immortality may not be so smooth. The conflicts between the nobles and the eunuchs in this world are irreconcilable. If you accept those eunuchs for your own use, problems will arise sooner or later."
"You don't need to worry about it. If you want to know the news about the beautiful Queen Mother, it depends on your performance."
Now the air was filled with the divine power of joy and desire. Looking at her charming and sultry look, Zu An felt the urge to punish her severely.
The God of Joy and Desire let out a soul-stirring laugh, and his long legs naturally hooked him, and the two of them rolled onto the dragon bed.
The maids in the palace closed the door tacitly. It was clear that the emperor had just passed away and the queen was hanging out with other men here, but everyone seemed to have become accustomed to it.
…
I don't know how long it took, but suddenly there was a tiger roar, and Zu An said in a shocked and angry voice: "What did you do to me?"
"Isn't it just that I have absorbed a little bit of the power from the soul fragments? Don't be so excited." The God of Joy and Desire stretched his brows and looked satisfied.
